issue_title_zh: Anthropic 路演：Q3 营收飙至 168 亿，调整后已盈利，IPO 估值瞄 2 万亿
lead_zh: 今天读路透社（RTE 转载）对 Anthropic 旧金山投资者日的报道。Q3 营收环比增 45% 至 168 亿美元，并称调整后已盈利；Amodei 谈安全却避谈「人类灭绝」，帽子上写着 thinking。重点看：assuage / on an adjusted basis / breakneck / outrun / twelvefold 这类财经与科技套话。

article.title: Anthropic pre-IPO meeting hears of surging revenue, no human extinction
article.author: Milana Vinn
article.excerpt_note: 节选自原文开篇营收与投资者日段落，以及融资规模与亏损背景（约 410 词）。版权归 Reuters 所有，仅供个人学习，完整报道请看原文。
sections: Anthropic has told prospective investors that revenue in the third quarter surged 45% from the prior quarter, two people who attended an investor day said, a move that could assuage market concerns about the huge costs of developing AI systems.
Third-quarter revenue rose to $16.8 billion from $11.6 billion in the second quarter and $4.7 billion in the first quarter, the people said.
Anthropic told the group the company was profitable on an adjusted basis in the third quarter, they added.
The meeting in San Francisco was meant to familiarise prospective Anthropic investors with the company before its highly anticipated IPO.

The IPO is expected to precede a public listing by rival OpenAI, making Anthropic an early test of investor appetite for loss-making AI developers investing heavily to pursue massive scale. Its public-market debut is likely to be pushed until after the November US midterm elections, Reuters has reported.

Attendees at yesterday's event met with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao and came away optimistic about the company's rapid revenue growth and path to profitability, a few of them told Reuters as they left its headquarters in the evening.
Amodei reiterated the company’s focus on AI safety but avoided mentioning threats of human extinction, one person in the group said.
In its prospectus seen by Reuters last month, Anthropic warned that advanced AI could pose "catastrophic or existential risks to humanity."

Anthropic executives yesterday, however, talked about how the company was using its AI to help its own business including designing a custom chip. The company handed out hats to the attendees, some of which read "thinking."
Anthropic could see its annual revenue run rate reach $110 billion by the end of the year, according to estimates from analysts who met with company executives earlier this week.
Scrutiny of AI companies' finances has intensified as they pour money into chips, data centres and computing power needed to develop and operate increasingly powerful models.
Targeting a valuation of over $2 trillion, Anthropic is seeking to convince investors that its breakneck revenue growth can eventually outrun the enormous costs of building and running AI systems.

Last year, Anthropic's revenue increased twelvefold to nearly $4.6 billion, even as the company lost more than $8 billion on an operating basis, excluding writedowns of various liabilities mostly tied to previous fundraising, Reuters reported exclusively last month.
The company has committed at least $518 billion over a decade for cloud services, computing and infrastructure.

notes.head: surge
notes.zh: 激增、飙升。surged 45% = 猛增 45%。比 rose / increased 更猛。名词 a surge in revenue。

notes.head: assuage
notes.zh: 缓和、减轻（担忧/痛苦）。assuage concerns = 安抚市场担忧。偏书面。

notes.head: the cost(s) of doing
notes.zh: 做某事的成本。the huge costs of developing AI systems = 开发 AI 系统的巨额成本。

notes.head: billion
notes.zh: 十亿（美式）。$16.8 billion = 168 亿美元。读作 sixteen point eight billion。

notes.head: on an adjusted basis
notes.zh: 按调整后口径。剔除一次性开支等后算「盈利」。财报常用 adjusted / non-GAAP。

notes.head: familiarise (with)
notes.zh: 使熟悉。英式拼写 familiarise（美式 familiarize）。familiarise investors with the company = 让投资者了解公司。

notes.head: IPO
notes.zh: 首次公开募股（Initial Public Offering）。highly anticipated = 备受期待的。

notes.head: precede
notes.zh: 先于、在……之前发生。precede a listing by OpenAI = 抢在 OpenAI 上市之前。

notes.head: appetite for
notes.zh: 对……的胃口/兴趣。investor appetite for … = 投资者对……的购买意愿。

notes.head: pursue
notes.zh: 追求、追逐。pursue massive scale = 追求超大规模。AI 公司常说 scale。

notes.head: debut
notes.zh: 首次亮相。public-market debut = 公开市场首秀（即上市）。

notes.head: come away + adj.
notes.zh: 离开时带着某种感受。came away optimistic = 散场时感到乐观。

notes.head: path to profitability
notes.zh: 通向盈利之路。创业/AI 融资常用：path to profitability / path to positive cash flow。

notes.head: 弯引号 ’
notes.zh: 注意 company’s 用的是弯引号（’），不是直引号 (')。锚定原文时要一字不差。

notes.head: extinction
notes.zh: 灭绝。human extinction = 人类灭绝。AI 安全讨论里的极端风险说法。

notes.head: existential risk
notes.zh: 存在性风险（可能威胁人类存续）。prospectus 招股书里的警示语。

notes.head: custom chip
notes.zh: 定制芯片。用自家 AI 帮自己设计芯片，显示「AI 赋能业务」叙事。

notes.head: run rate
notes.zh: 年化运行速率。annual revenue run rate = 按当前季度年化后的营收规模（未必等于全年实际）。

notes.head: scrutiny
notes.zh: 严格审视、审查。Scrutiny of … has intensified = 对……的审视加剧。

notes.head: data centre
notes.zh: 数据中心。英式 centres（美式 centers）。chips, data centres and computing power = 芯片、数据中心与算力。

notes.head: 现在分词作状语
notes.zh: 句首 Targeting… = 以……估值为目标。新闻里常用分词短语领起背景。

notes.head: breakneck
notes.zh: 快得危险的、极快的。breakneck growth / speed = 飞奔式增长。

notes.head: outrun
notes.zh: 跑得比……快、超过。outrun the costs = 增长跑赢成本。

notes.head: twelvefold
notes.zh: 增至十二倍（增长十一倍）。-fold 表倍数：twofold / tenfold / twelvefold。

notes.head: on an … basis
notes.zh: 按……口径。on an operating basis = 按经营口径（未计某些非经常项前）。对照上文 adjusted basis。

notes.head: writedown
notes.zh: 减值/减记。writedown of liabilities = 对负债的减记。会计术语。

notes.head: commit
notes.zh: 承诺投入。has committed $518 billion = 已承诺至少 5180 亿美元（云与算力合同）。

notes.head: over a decade
notes.zh: 在十年期间。over a decade = 跨越约十年。

review_words.example: Revenue in the third quarter surged 45% from the prior quarter.
The numbers could assuage market concerns about AI costs.
The company was profitable on an adjusted basis.
The meeting was meant to familiarise investors with the company.
It is an early test of investor appetite for AI developers.
Its public-market debut may wait until after the midterms.
Amodei avoided mentioning threats of human extinction.
The prospectus warned of existential risks to humanity.
Analysts see a $110 billion annual revenue run rate.
Scrutiny of AI companies' finances has intensified.

review_words.zh: adj. 极快的，快得危险的
review_words.example: Breakneck revenue growth must outrun enormous costs.
Growth must eventually outrun the costs of building AI.
Revenue increased twelvefold to nearly $4.6 billion.
Losses excluded writedowns of various liabilities.

patterns.pattern: A told B that C surged X% from D, a move that could assuage E
patterns.zh: A 告诉 B：C 较 D 激增 X%，此举可能缓和 E
patterns.from: Anthropic has told prospective investors that revenue in the third quarter surged 45% from the prior quarter… a move that could assuage market concerns…
patterns.model: The CFO told analysts that bookings surged 30% from last quarter, a move that could assuage growth concerns.
patterns.model_zh: CFO 告诉分析师：订单较上季激增 30%，此举可能缓和增长担忧。

patterns.pattern: A is expected to precede B, making C an early test of D
patterns.zh: A 预计先于 B，使 C 成为对 D 的早期考验
patterns.from: The IPO is expected to precede a public listing by rival OpenAI, making Anthropic an early test of investor appetite…
patterns.model: The chip launch is expected to precede rival releases, making it an early test of demand.
patterns.model_zh: 这款芯片发布预计先于对手，成为需求的早期考验。

patterns.pattern: A is seeking to convince B that C can eventually outrun D
patterns.zh: A 试图说服 B：C 最终能跑赢 D
patterns.from: Anthropic is seeking to convince investors that its breakneck revenue growth can eventually outrun the enormous costs…
patterns.model: Startups are seeking to convince VCs that efficiency gains can eventually outrun cloud bills.
patterns.model_zh: 创业公司试图说服风投：效率提升最终能跑赢云账单。

patterns.pattern: A increased N-fold to X, even as B lost Y on a Z basis
patterns.zh: A 增至 N 倍达到 X，即便 B 按 Z 口径亏损 Y
patterns.from: Anthropic's revenue increased twelvefold to nearly $4.6 billion, even as the company lost more than $8 billion on an operating basis…
patterns.model: Sales increased fivefold to $2 billion, even as the firm lost $500 million on an operating basis.
patterns.model_zh: 销售额增至五倍达到 20 亿美元，即便公司按经营口径亏损 5 亿美元。

podcast.title: Is Anthropic's $2 Trillion IPO in Jeopardy? What We Learned from Leaked IPO Prospectus
podcast.zh: 拆解 Anthropic 泄露招股书里的营收、亏损、5180 亿算力承诺与安全叙事，和今天投资者日上的 Q3 数字、2 万亿估值同一条主线，适合泛听抓 IPO / run rate / existential risk。
